auth.portalHint: City parking portal in the browser. Same citizen services as mobile, plus admin screens here.
auth.heroTitle: District parking — from screen to stall.
auth.heroBody: Pay your session, watch live occupancy, and find your car indoors — one polished portal.
auth.demoHint: Demo accounts: citizen1, visitor1, employee1, admin1, admin — password admin
auth.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait one minute and try again.
auth.serverError: The platform could not complete sign-in. This is a server failure, not demo data.

home.title: Home
home.visitorBody: You are a visitor. Pay on this portal, then you have time to exit. If a resident sent an invite code, check it here. The barrier opens after verification — not from this screen.
home.citizenBody: You are a resident. Check live occupancy and your vehicle, and pay if a session is open. You can also buy a bundle, reserve a slot, show the QR pass, and open district services.
home.employeeBody: You are an employee — a parking user, not a building operator. Occupancy, session, vehicle, subscription, and reservations are on this portal.
home.adminBody: You are a platform admin. Watch live occupancy, search plates, and open reports, grace violations, and support tickets.
home.hintOccupancy: Green is free, red is occupied, updating live.
home.hintSession: Open session, payment, and the 20-minute exit grace.
home.hintFindCar: Your vehicle's location in the parking, from the platform.
home.hintSubs: Buy or renew a parking bundle (resident and staff).
home.hintReserve: Book a slot for a time window, or view an existing booking.
home.hintInvite: Enter an invite code. The barrier is not opened here.
home.hintPass: QR pass for the gate. The barrier is not opened from this screen.
home.hintEv: Building chargers that are free or occupied.
home.hintBilling: District invoices due. Payment is not from this portal.
home.hintTickets: Lost ticket, barrier fault, waste, or maintenance.
home.hintGrace: Paid sessions whose exit grace has ended and are still inside.
home.hintBindings: See who owns a plate and unlink it without deleting LPR reads.

profile.title: Account
profile.name: Name
profile.vehiclesHint: Add vehicles in the mobile app. Here you can only unlink a plate from this account.

occupancy.title: Occupancy
occupancy.guidanceHint: Green is free and red is occupied, matching the bay lights. Counts are per zone and update live.

admin.title: Occupancy board
admin.subtitle: Live figures for building {{buildingId}}
admin.subtitleAll: Live figures from the platform for every building

session.title: Parking session
session.pageHint: Current stay, duration, amount due, and exit grace after payment.
session.opsHint: Live sessions in the garage: plate, bay, duration, and amount. Updates from the platform.
session.opsEmptyBody: When a vehicle enters through the gate it appears here: plate, lot, duration, and amount due.
session.empty: No current session. Pay here when you enter the parking.
session.emptyCitizen: No open session. You can subscribe or reserve a slot from this portal.
session.emptyEmployee: No parking session right now. Check occupancy, subscribe, or reserve a slot.
session.emptyAdmin: No personal session. Occupancy board and reports are in the side menu.
session.graceNote: After payment you have {{minutes}} minutes to exit.
session.graceActive: You can exit within {{remaining}} ({{minutes}}-minute grace after payment).
session.graceExpired: The grace period has ended. Pay the extra fee at the parking cashier. This portal does not open the barrier.
session.graceExpiredFee: The grace period has ended. Extra fee {{amount}} {{currency}} is paid at the parking cashier. This portal does not open the barrier.
session.endSessionConfirm: Confirm ending session #{{sessionId}} and exit for vehicle {{plate}}?
session.endSessionSuccess: Session ended successfully and bay released.
session.quickPayHint: Pay current session fees and activate exit grace period.

payment.title: Payment
payment.note: After confirmation you have {{minutes}} minutes to exit. Payment runs through the platform. The barrier is not opened from the browser.
payment.success: Payment captured. You have {{minutes}} minutes to exit before grace ends.
payment.noSession: There is no session to pay.

tickets.title: Support ticket
tickets.hint: A lost ticket is resolved at the parking cashier. A barrier fault is a report only — the web app does not open the barrier. Waste and maintenance are district services.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.hint: Your parking sessions and payment receipts from the platform.
receipts.opsHint: Paid and closed sessions in the garage — from the platform ledger.
receipts.emptyOps: No payments in the ledger yet. They appear here after a session is paid or closed.
receipts.empty: No receipts yet. They appear here after payment.
receipts.detailHint: Receipt for a specific session from the platform. It appears after payment.
receipts.missing: No receipt for this session. It appears after payment.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.pendingApi: This screen is ready. If the platform has not published the route yet, local data is shown until the asks file is implemented.

subs.title: Subscription
subs.hint: City web portal channel: buy or renew a parking bundle. The main slot is guaranteed for the term.
subs.guaranteed: Guaranteed main slot for the full term.
subs.optional: Optional access if a space is free.
subs.residentsOnly: Subscriptions are for residents and staff. Visitors pay the session.

reserve.title: Reservations
reserve.hint: Book a slot for a time window. Residents/staff can invite a visitor. The web app does not open the barrier.

plates.title: Plate search
plates.hint: Partial plate lookup across buildings. Admin/operator by platform permission.

bindings.title: Unlink vehicle
bindings.hint: Cameras do not attach a plate to an account. Flutter adds the car. Use this page to unlink a mistaken binding.
bindings.flutterOwns: The plate belongs to whoever adds it in the mobile app (POST /me/vehicles). The LPR monitor does not register a vehicle.
bindings.unlinked: Unlinked. The plate can be added again from Flutter.

reports.title: Occupancy reports
reports.hint: Live figures: occupancy, today's revenue, grace violations, active subscriptions.

users.title: Users
users.hint: Read-only list in this phase. Role creation stays on the platform.

grace.title: Grace violations
grace.hint: After payment there are {{minutes}} minutes to exit. If the vehicle is still inside after that, the extra fee is paid at the cashier. The web app does not open the barrier or collect the fine.

invite.title: Invite code
invite.hint: An invited visitor enters the code sent by the resident or employee. The gate checks it on the platform. This screen does not open the barrier.
invite.noBarrier: This screen only shows the booking. The barrier is not opened from the browser.

adminTickets.title: Support tickets
adminTickets.hint: Read-only queue of tickets. Lost tickets and barrier faults are resolved at the parking cashier. The web app does not close the barrier.

pass.title: Access pass
pass.hint: Show the code at the gate. The barrier opens after platform verification — not from this screen.
pass.empty: No pass right now. It appears after payment or with an active subscription.
pass.noBarrier: This is a display pass only. The web app does not open the barrier.

ev.title: EV chargers
ev.hint: Chargers for your building. Status comes from the platform.
ev.manageHint: Add charger locations, update free ports, or remove a station.
ev.empty: No chargers listed for this building.
ev.emptyAdmin: No charger stations yet. Add a location for this building.
ev.name: Location name
ev.deleteConfirm: Delete station “{{name}}”? It will disappear from this screen.
ev.countsInvalid: Free ports cannot exceed total, and total must be at least 1.

billing.title: District invoices
billing.hint: Outstanding invoices. Collection is through district finance (ERP). This portal is view-only — do not pay invoices here.
billing.noPay: Collection is via ERP / a payment platform later. Not from this screen, and not at the parking cashier.

icons.legendHint: Every icon has a name and meaning — hover sidebar items for details.

opsUsers.title: User management
opsUsers.hint: Same as WPF Users page: create, update, activate, reset password, roles and permissions.
opsUsers.passwordHint: At least 8 chars with a letter and a digit.

opsCameras.title: Cameras
opsCameras.hint: Same WPF flow: ONVIF probe then save StreamUrl (IPRO listen) and RtspUrl (video).
opsCameras.deleteFail: Could not delete camera (linked to LPR events or parking data).
opsCameras.name: Name
opsCameras.streamUrlHint: IPRO listen address only: IP:Port — not RTSP.
opsCameras.snapshotHint: HTTP JPEG for browser preview. Panasonic example: http://192.168.1.55/cgi-bin/camera?resolution=640
opsCameras.probeCloudWarning: Cloud probe may not reach the camera (192.168.x). Live preview loads from your browser directly — set SnapshotUrl or Manufacturer (Panasonic) and password.
opsCameras.cloudPreviewBlocked: Preview goes from your browser straight to the camera. If no image appears, re-save the camera with its password.
opsCameras.streamExplain: StreamUrl = IPRO listener host:port (e.g. 192.168.1.229:40000). After Probe, real RTSP is stored in RtspUrl. The browser shows snapshots via GET /cameras/{id}/snapshot because raw RTSP does not play in browsers.
opsCameras.addFlow: 1) Enter IP, user, password. 2) Probe ONVIF. 3) Review RTSP then create. StreamUrl stays the listen address.
opsCameras.locationHint: From Google Maps paste latitude then longitude (example 30.0603, 31.2039). Swapping them drops the pin in the wrong city.

opsSettings.title: Settings
opsSettings.hint: Configure cameras and monitor grid layouts for LPR live view.
opsSettings.camerasDesc: Add cameras, ONVIF probe, StreamUrl and RTSP — same as WPF.
opsSettings.viewsDesc: Define grid layouts (rows × columns) and assign cameras to each cell.
opsSettings.flowHint: Workflow: add cameras → create a view → open LPR monitor to see the grid live.

opsViews.title: Monitor views
opsViews.hint: Each view defines how many cameras appear on the LPR page (rows × columns).
opsViews.empty: No views yet. Create one to layout the LPR monitor.
opsViews.name: View name
opsViews.confirmChangeCamera: Replace "{{oldName}}" with "{{newName}}" in cell R{{row}} C{{col}}?

opsLpr.title: LPR monitor
opsLpr.hint: Multi-camera live grid driven by your saved views.
opsLpr.gridHint: Command deck — live video plus the last 10 plates per camera.
opsLpr.streamHint: If the camera has no SnapshotUrl, the preview falls back to the latest LPR plate image.
opsLpr.liveHint: Set SnapshotUrl (HTTP reachable from the API) or RtspUrl with FFmpeg on the API host. StreamUrl is IPRO listen only — not a browser video URL.
opsLpr.liveVideoHint: Live MJPEG from the platform (browser RTSP alternative — Deep Guard idea without a full Gateway).
opsLpr.snapshotUnavailable: Camera snapshot unavailable — set SnapshotUrl or rely on LPR preview.
opsLpr.cloudLanHint: nri.runasp.net cannot reach LAN camera IPs (192.168.x). Run Parking.Api on the same network as the cameras, or publish a public SnapshotUrl.
opsLpr.directLanHint: Preview loads directly from your browser to the camera on your LAN (not via the cloud server).
opsLpr.directLanFailed: Could not load an image from the camera directly. Re-save the camera with its password or set SnapshotUrl.
opsLpr.directLanPasswordHint: Enter the camera password here, or edit the camera and save with the password.
opsLpr.directLanDevOnly: LAN live preview works via npm run dev on the same network as the camera.
opsLpr.localApiSteps: Fix: run Parking.Api locally (dotnet run) and set VITE_API_ORIGIN=http://localhost:5088 in NRI_web/.env.local
opsLpr.usingLprFallback: Live stream unavailable — showing latest LPR plate/vehicle image instead.
opsLpr.previewFromLpr: Preview from latest plate event (snapshot fallback)
opsLpr.hybridNote: Events arrive on SignalR first; if the hub is down, REST refreshes every 3s — same as WPF.
opsLpr.noViewConfigured: No monitor view configured. Create a view under Settings and assign cameras to grid cells.
opsLpr.lastTenHint: Newest in — oldest drops off automatically
opsLpr.waitingRecognition: Waiting for the first plate read…

freePlaces.title: Free places
freePlaces.hint: Add a building, zone, parking lot, then places — or free occupied bays instantly.
freePlaces.how: The chain is building → zone → parking lot → place. Use Add full site to create the chain in one go, without a camera.
freePlaces.freedOne: Place freed — watch the occupancy page.
freePlaces.wizardHint: Building, zone, parking lot with coordinates, then how many places. A camera is optional later.
freePlaces.noBuildings: No buildings yet. Add a building to start.
freePlaces.noZones: Pick a building, then add a zone.
freePlaces.noParkings: Pick a zone, then add a parking lot.
freePlaces.needBuilding: Pick or create a building first.
freePlaces.needZone: Pick or create a zone first.
freePlaces.pickFirst: Start with the building, then the zone, then the lot.
freePlaces.needCoords: Enter the parking lot latitude and longitude (for example 30.0444 and 31.2357).
freePlaces.coordsHint: From Google Maps paste latitude then longitude: 30.0603, 31.2039 — not the reverse.
freePlaces.placeCoordsHint: Optional. Leave empty to use the lot coordinates. Add bay coordinates for a more precise pin.
freePlaces.deleteBuildingConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete building "{{name}}"?
freePlaces.deleteZoneConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete zone "{{name}}"?
freePlaces.deleteParkingConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete parking lot "{{name}}"?
freePlaces.deletePlaceConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete place "{{name}}"?

simulator.title: Gate & LPR Entry Simulator
simulator.hint: Real-time camera & gate simulation for visitor entry/exit, spot reservation matching, and live indoor map tracking.
simulator.autoAssignPlace: Auto-assigned from reservation or nearest vacant spot
simulator.noActiveSessions: No active live sessions at the moment.
simulator.entrySuccess: Vehicle entry simulated successfully. Barrier opened and session #{{id}} started.
simulator.exitSuccess: Vehicle exit simulated successfully. Session #{{id}} closed and bay freed.

findCar.title: Find my car
findCar.hint: Your vehicles only. The platform resolves the location. This browser does not calculate the route.
findCar.noVehicles: No vehicles registered. Add a plate here or from the account.
findCar.noVehiclesBody: Add your plate first. After parking, this screen shows building, zone, lot, then bay so you can walk to the car.
findCar.parkedHint: Your car is parked now. Open to see the building, lot, and bay.
findCar.addPlateHint: Use the same plate as the live session or invite. Then we can find the bay.
findCar.adminMode: Admin mode: You can search for any vehicle in the facility directly and view its location on the map.
findCar.searchPlateHint: Enter any plate number (Arabic or English) to instantly view its spot and walking route.
findCar.resultHint: Details come from the platform: building, zone, lot, and bay. The map appears when coordinates are saved.
findCar.notFound: No location for this vehicle right now.
findCar.zoneLaneOnly: No bay number. Zone or lane only.
findCar.routeUnavailable: An indoor walking map is not available yet. Use the building, lot, and bay path above.
findCar.locationUnavailable: No GPS coordinates yet. Add latitude and longitude on the parking lot, place, or camera.
findCar.geoHint: Add parking-lot or place coordinates from Free places or Cameras so the map can appear here.
findCar.coordsSwapped: The saved values were reversed (longitude then latitude). The map shows the corrected pin.
findCar.historyEmpty: No location history for this vehicle yet.
